newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Angolan rail line reopens after seven year closure.
newsitem.headline: Angolan rail line reopens after seven year closure.

text.p: A 180 kilometre section of railway opened from the capital of Angola to the interior of the country for the first time in seven years on Friday, the Angolan press reported.
The rail line, from Luanda to the city of Dondo in Kwanza Norte Province, had been closed mainly because of Angola's long running civil war.
The director of Luanda Railways, Antonio Agante, said the rehabilitation of the line would continue to the city of Malanje, the capital of Malanje Province.
Agante said three bridges needed to be repaired between Dondo and Malanje, but he said the line should be completed by the end of the year.
